title: Text Splitters
summary: This module provides various strategies for splitting text into smaller, manageable chunks, including token-based, HTML-aware, JSON-aware, and spaCy-based methods, while preserving semantic structure and metadata.

nodes.label: Token Text Splitter
nodes.title: Token Text Splitter
nodes.description: Splits text into tokens using a specified model tokenizer (e.g., GPT-2's tiktoken), allowing for precise control over chunk size and overlap based on token counts.

nodes.label: HTML Header Text Splitter
nodes.title: HTML Header Text Splitter
nodes.description: Splits HTML content into structured documents based on specified header tags (e.g., h1, h2), preserving the hierarchical semantic structure and associating text with header metadata.

nodes.label: HTML Semantic Preserving Splitter
nodes.title: HTML Semantic Preserving Splitter
nodes.description: Splits HTML content into generalized chunks while preserving semantic structure, handling links, images, and other elements, and using a recursive splitter for further chunking if needed.

nodes.label: HTML Section Splitter
nodes.title: HTML Section Splitter
nodes.description: Splits HTML files into sections based on specified header tags, converting certain HTML tags to headers for consistent parsing and creating documents with associated metadata.

nodes.label: Recursive JSON Splitter
nodes.title: Recursive JSON Splitter
nodes.description: Splits JSON data into smaller, structured chunks (dictionaries or strings) while preserving the hierarchical structure, based on configurable maximum and minimum chunk sizes.

nodes.label: SpaCy Text Splitter
nodes.title: SpaCy Text Splitter
nodes.description: Splits text into sentences using the spaCy natural language processing library, providing language-aware text segmentation with configurable pipeline and maximum length.

nodes.label: Document Loader
nodes.title: Document Loader
nodes.description: External component responsible for loading raw text or structured data into a standardized Document format for processing.

nodes.label: Document Transformer
nodes.title: Document Transformer
nodes.description: External component that transforms a sequence of documents, often used as an interface for splitters that operate on Document objects.

groups.label: Token-Based Splitting
groups.title: Token-Based Splitting
groups.description: Components that split text based on token counts, often using language model tokenizers for precise control.

groups.label: HTML Splitting
groups.title: HTML Content Splitting
groups.description: Components designed to parse and split HTML content, preserving its semantic structure and extracting relevant information.

groups.label: Structured Data Splitting
groups.title: Structured Data Splitting
groups.description: Components for splitting structured data formats like JSON while maintaining their hierarchical integrity.

groups.label: NLP-Based Splitting
groups.title: NLP-Based Splitting
groups.description: Components leveraging natural language processing libraries to split text based on linguistic structures like sentences.
